item.title: Croatian fishermen feel the strain after Iran war ramps up fuel prices

item.title: Myanmar military chief who led 2021 army takeover takes presidency after criticized election
item.summary: Min Aung Hlaing, the army chief who ousted Aung San Suu Kyi's civilian government five years ago, has been sworn in as Myanmar's president

item.summary: Iranians have welcomed a ceasefire deal after weeks of Israeli and American bombardment, but many fear the war is far from over

item.summary: The China Association of Automobile Manufacturers says Chinese exports of passenger cars have accelerated in March

item.summary: Hundreds of volunteers have joined a "Frog Patrol" initiative in a forest near the Polish capital of Warsaw to help amphibians survive road crossings during their spring mating rituals

item.title: Former Russian deputy defense minister is sentenced to 19 years for corruption
